articles.title: Spec Strength
articles.summary: Overall strength of the spec map (shine / metal / coat) of this zone. It is a slider.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > ZONE POPOUT PANEL (click a zone card in the left column; Shift+E shows / hides the panel) > BASE. Range 0-100%, starts at 100%.
when: Make the finish less (or more) reflective without moving the colour.
how: Drag the slider, or click it and use the arrow keys.

controls.label: Spec Strength
controls.effect: Overall strength of the spec map (shine / metal / coat) of this zone

deep.heading: What it changes
deep.body: Weakens (or boosts) the finish's MATERIAL: metal / roughness / clearcoat move toward neutral. Colour unchanged. Applies to: Every base / finish with a non-neutral material (metallic, chrome, candy).

deep.heading: Under the hood
deep.body: Behind the scenes it sets the zone base spec strength. It runs over 0-100% and starts at 100%. Measured in %.

deep.heading: How it combines with other controls
deep.body: Separate from Base Strength (paint). Zone spec_shift adds on top.

protips: Typical values: 'less shiny / tone down the metal' -> 50-70%; 'more metallic' -> 120-150.

faq.q: What does Spec Strength do?
faq.a: Overall strength of the spec map (shine / metal / coat) of this zone.

faq.q: When should I use Spec Strength?
faq.a: Make the finish less (or more) reflective without moving the colour.

faq.q: What is the range and starting value of Spec Strength?
faq.a: Range 0-100%. It starts at 100%.

combos.why: Works together with the Base Strength control.

articles.title: Independent Spec (checkbox by Spec Scale)
articles.summary: Lets Spec Scale differ from Base Scale; otherwise spec follows the base size. It is an on/off switch.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > ZONE POPOUT PANEL (click a zone card in the left column; Shift+E shows / hides the panel) > BASE. Range scale 0.05-5x; rotation 0-355, starts at follows Base Scale / 0.
when: Want the shine texture finer or coarser than the colour texture.

articles.title: Spec Blend
articles.summary: How a pattern changes this base's optics: Normal, Ghost Carve, Chrome Inlay, Frost Etch, Angle Flip, Ember Gate, Depth Press, and legacy Multiply / Screen / Overlay... It is a drop-down menu.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > ZONE POPOUT PANEL (click a zone card in the left column; Shift+E shows / hides the panel) > BASE. Range -127..127 each (step 5), starts at 0/0/0.
when: Pattern should alter shine / metal rather than just brightness.
how: Open the menu and pick a choice.

controls.label: Spec Blend
controls.effect: How a pattern changes this base's optics: Normal, Ghost Carve, Chrome Inlay...

deep.heading: What it changes
deep.body: Metal + = more metallic everywhere in the zone; Rough + = duller / matter, - = glossier; Clearcoat shift moves the gloss layer (REMEMBER B=clearcoat is inverted: 16 = max gloss, higher = duller; floor is 16). Applies to: Every zone; applied last on top of patterns, overlays and blend modes.

deep.heading: Under the hood
deep.body: It runs over -127..127 each (step 5) and starts at 0/0/0. Measured in spec units (0-255 channel).

protips: Typical values: Direct 'make it satin / more matte' -> rough +40..+80 and clearcoat +30..+60; 'high gloss / wet' -> rough -40, clearcoat -10 (floors apply); 'more metal' -> metal +50..+90.

faq.q: What does Spec Blend do?
faq.a: How a pattern changes this base's optics: Normal, Ghost Carve, Chrome Inlay, Frost Etch, Angle Flip, Ember Gate, Depth Press, and legacy Multiply / Screen / Overlay...

faq.q: When should I use Spec Blend?
faq.a: Pattern should alter shine / metal rather than just brightness.

faq.q: What is the range and starting value of Spec Blend?
faq.a: Range -127..127 each (step 5). It starts at 0/0/0.

combos.why: Works together with the Pattern 1 picker (name + dropdown arrow) control.

articles.title: ADD SPEC OVERLAY
articles.summary: Opens the spec-overlay picker to add one more spec texture layer. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > ZONE POPOUT PANEL (click a zone card in the left column; Shift+E shows / hides the panel) > BASE > SPEC.... Range opacity 0-100, scale 0.1-4 / 0.05-5, rotation 0-359, channels any of M R C, blend normal|multiply|screen|overlay, starts at empty; a new layer takes the spec pattern's own defaults (opacity default 50).

controls.label: ADD SPEC OVERLAY
controls.range: opacity 0-100, scale 0.1-4 / 0.05-5, rotation 0-359, channels any of M R C, blend normal|multiply|screen|overlay
controls.default: empty; a new layer takes the spec pattern's own defaults (opacity default 50)
controls.effect: Opens the spec-overlay picker to add one more spec texture layer

pitfalls: Up to 5 layers on the primary base.

deep.heading: What it changes
deep.body: Adds a micro-texture to HOW the surface reflects: e.g. a reptile-scale spec makes light catch on each scale; flake spec = sparkle; brushed = directional sheen. Applies to: ANY zone. Spec patterns change shine / metal / clearcoat texture only, never the paint colour (the picture looks the same in a flat preview - check spec).

deep.heading: Under the hood
deep.body: It runs over opacity 0-100, scale 0.1-4 / 0.05-5, rotation 0-359, channels any of M R C, blend normal|multiply|screen|overlay and starts at empty; a new layer takes the spec pattern's own defaults (opacity default 50). Measured in layers.

deep.heading: How it combines with other controls
deep.body: channels decide which of Metal / Rough / Clearcoat it modulates (default inferred from the pattern's own docstring). Opacity is the strength; Range is how far values swing. Spec strength / spec shift apply on top. Not visible in the flat colour preview.

protips: Typical values: To weave a pattern 'in' without changing colour: spec_patterns:[{id:'<reptile or scale spec>',opacity:50-70,scale:0.4-0.6,channels:'MR'}] and a satin base. Stack up to 3 layers: a fine flake (scale 0.3) + the scale pattern (0.5) + a brushed grain.

faq.q: What does + ADD SPEC OVERLAY do?
faq.a: Opens the spec-overlay picker to add one more spec texture layer.

faq.q: When should I use + ADD SPEC OVERLAY?
faq.a: Add a shine texture.

faq.q: What is the range and starting value of + ADD SPEC OVERLAY?
faq.a: Range opacity 0-100, scale 0.1-4 / 0.05-5, rotation 0-359, channels any of M R C, blend normal|multiply|screen|overlay. It starts at empty; a new layer takes the spec pattern's own defaults (opacity...

faq.q: Why does + ADD SPEC OVERLAY not seem to do what I expect?
faq.a: Up to 5 layers on the primary base.
